tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content: **Sentinel Surveillance** provides real-time security monitoring for large industrial complexes. They use Microsoft Sentinel to ingest logs from various sources, including Azure resources and on-premises servers. The SOC team operates 24/7 across two shifts.

tabs.title: Monitoring Requirements
tabs.content:
- Detect and respond to brute-force attacks on virtual machines in real-time, with geographic visualization of attack sources.
- Automate the response to common security incidents using Playbooks (e.g., automatically block attacker IPs in NSGs).
- Ensure that all security logs are retained for a minimum of 365 days for compliance auditing, using the most cost-effective retention strategy.
